payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Brain, Gaylene, Harmony, Logan, Milly, Ronna

payload.content: Harmony planning note: I have 5h availability and very high cost on ISSUE-0002 tasks. Best feasible/low-cost option for me is ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 5.77, low priority) or possibly skip if another agent needs the low-cost triage more. I’m open to taking ISSUE-0001::triage unless someone else has a better fit and will claim it.

Milly planning note: I have 10h availability and my best-fit/lowest-cost feasible option is ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 7.99). I’m willing to claim it in execution unless coordination suggests someone else should take it. I will avoid ISSUE-0002 because my costs there are much higher.

Logan planning note: I have 5h availability and the lowest-cost feasible task for me is ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 3.09), with ISSUE-0001::review/docs next at 3.86 and ISSUE-0002 tasks prohibitively expensive. To avoid duplicate claims, I propose I take ISSUE-0001::triage if no one else has a stronger need for it; otherwise I can skip. Please coordinate so only one agent claims triage.

Brain planning note: I have 5h availability. My feasible low-cost options are ISSUE-0002::review (cost 2.15) and ISSUE-0002::test (3.01), with review clearly best. I propose I take ISSUE-0002::review in execution unless another agent has a stronger reason to claim it. I will avoid ISSUE-0001 tasks due to high cost.

Ronna planning note: I have 7h availability and data-science skill. My lowest-cost feasible option is ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 6.11), with ISSUE-0001::docs/review also feasible but higher cost, and ISSUE-0002 tasks far too expensive. To avoid duplicate claims, I propose I take ISSUE-0001::triage if no one else is better positioned for it; otherwise I can skip. Please coordinate so triage is only claimed once.

Gaylene planning note: I have 5h availability and documentation skill. My lowest-cost feasible options are ISSUE-0001::triage (6.92), ISSUE-0001::docs/review (8.64), but all are above my availability-adjusted comfort and still relatively costly. I’m willing to skip if needed to avoid duplicates, but if triage remains unclaimed I can take it. Please coordinate so only one agent claims ISSUE-0001::triage, and feel free to prioritize the lower-cost ISSUE-0002::review for others.

Harmony update: I’m leaning to SKIP in execution unless coordination leaves ISSUE-0001::triage unclaimed. Multiple agents have lower-cost triage options than me, and Brain has a strong fit for ISSUE-0002::review. To maximize completed tasks and avoid duplicates, I suggest: Brain -> ISSUE-0002::review, one of Logan/Milly/Ronna/Gaylene -> ISSUE-0001::triage, and others take the remaining feasible low-cost tasks or skip. I will wait for final coordination before committing.

Milly update: I agree we should avoid duplicate triage claims. Given the current coordination, I’m happy to yield ISSUE-0001::triage if another agent is better positioned. My fallback options are poor, so I’m leaning to SKIP unless one of the other low-cost tasks becomes clearly unclaimed and feasible for me. Proposed allocation so far looks like Brain -> ISSUE-0002::review, Logan/Ronna/Gaylene/Harmony -> coordinate triage or skip, with only one person taking ISSUE-0001::triage.

Logan coordination update: I’m fine yielding ISSUE-0001::triage if another agent wants it more. To maximize completed tasks and avoid duplicates, I suggest Brain claims ISSUE-0002::review, one of Logan/Ronna/Gaylene/Harmony/Milly claims ISSUE-0001::triage, and any remaining feasible low-cost task (e.g., ISSUE-0001::docs or review) is only taken if clearly unclaimed. I’m leaning to triage or skip depending on final consensus.

Brain planning update: I’ll take ISSUE-0002::review in execution unless coordination changes. That leaves ISSUE-0002::test as a good fallback for another agent, and I recommend only one person claims ISSUE-0001::triage. If anyone has a stronger fit for review, please say so now; otherwise I’ll commit to review in execution.

Ronna coordination update: I’m willing to take ISSUE-0001::triage, but I also see a cleaner overall spread if I skip and let lower-cost triage candidates pick it up while Brain takes ISSUE-0002::review. If someone wants a second feasible task after review/triage are settled, ISSUE-0001::docs or ISSUE-0001::review are the next possibilities, but they’re higher cost for me. Please confirm final unique picks before execution.

Gaylene planning update: I’m aligned with the current coordination. I will likely SKIP unless ISSUE-0001::triage is still unclaimed at execution time. Given my higher cost on docs/review and the need to avoid duplicate claims, I support Brain taking ISSUE-0002::review and one lower-cost agent taking ISSUE-0001::triage. If triage is already claimed, I’ll skip rather than create a duplicate.

Harmony planning coordination: I’m confirming I will likely SKIP in execution unless triage remains unclaimed after final coordination. Milly final planning intent: I will SKIP in execution. Brain appears set for ISSUE-0002::review. Brain appears set for ISSUE-0002::review; Logan has reserved ISSUE-0001::docs if unclaimed; Ronna is also eyeing docs; Harmony and Milly are skipping. To avoid duplicates, please treat ISSUE-0001::triage as unclaimed unless another agent explicitly commits to it, and otherwise let the remaining agents skip or take only clearly unclaimed feasible tasks.
